Questions

Before you book

Does this form confirm my reservation?

No. It sends a request. The team will confirm availability and explain what is needed to complete the booking.

Can you handle dietary requests?

Share the requests during the call. The team will explain which menu options may be suitable.

Can I book a private room?

Private space depends on the date, group size and restaurant layout. The team will discuss available options.

How far ahead should I request catering?

More notice usually gives the team more room to plan, but you can submit your date to check availability.

Can I change the guest count later?

Often, yes. The team will give you a deadline for final numbers based on the booking type.
